messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — joint marketplace listing goes live next Wed. Need final owners for: press embargo windows per partner, landing page slices + CTA mapping, SI integration runbooks and cutover window, hardware partner badge assets + validation. Can people call dibs? Want owners by EOD today. :calendar: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-playbook

Tom: I can own press embargo scheduling and press kit handoff. Will build an embargo matrix and send by 4pm. Question — do we want a single global embargo or staggered regional drops? :thinking:

Alyssa: Prefer staggered regions (NA first, EU + APAC staggered) to reduce load and press collisions. We need partner-specific embargo rows (some partners require earlier notice). Jorge can you confirm HW partner timing?

Jorge: HW partner here — badge assets v2 are ready (SVG + PNG). We still need final legal approval for logo usage, but technical validation of devices is scheduled tomorrow 9–11am PST in our lab. I can take badge ownership and validation. Will upload assets to the shared drive after legal confirms.

Sophia: I can own the landing page cutover and A/B test wiring. Need final CTA mapping and feature-flag names. Example mapping I'd like to use:```json
{
  "cta_primary": "/signup?partner=redwood_hw",
  "cta_secondary": "/docs/marketplace-integration",
  "ab_test": "landing_variant_b"
}
```Can Marketing Ops give final copy for CTA text?

Ravi: SI integration lead — I'll own the SI runbook and partner onboarding playbook. Need test tenants and API keys from partners by EOD. Propose a dry-run rehearsal on Tuesday 10am PT where we simulate tenant provisioning + failover.

Linda: Marketing Ops here — I'll coordinate localized blog schedule and landing copy. I'll queue localization for 6 languages; need PR-approved headlines from Tom before I lock publish times. Also will own the press-to-blog content mapping spreadsheet.

Tom: Noted — will add partner-specific embargo rows and a public/private press tier column. Sharing embargo matrix link by 3:45pm. Also prepping a compressed press kit (1 PDF + assets zip).

Marketing Ops: Added landing content checklist and translations TODO to the launch doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-playbook#heading=h.6xq8j

DeployBot: staging deploy completed: `staging/marketplace-landing:v2.3` — smoke tests pass.

Alyssa: Great. Quick ownership recap: Tom = press embargo & kit, Jorge = HW badge + validation, Sophia = landing cutover + A/B, Ravi = SI runbook + rehearsal, Linda = localization & blog cadence. If anyone needs to swap, shout now. Otherwise I'll consolidate owners into the master playbook by 6pm. :white_check_mark:

Tom: :thumbsup: I'll ping legal for logo use today.

Jorge: Will follow up with lab logs and upload badges by EOD.

Sophia: Will draft feature-flag names and share them in the doc by 2pm.

Ravi: Adding rehearsal invite for Tue 10am PT now.

Linda: Locking localization queue after Tom's headlines. Thanks all.

Alyssa: Thanks team — will post the consolidated owner matrix in this thread when done.
